queries.query: Ziway Ethiopia official cadastral parcel map GIS land registry; Ethiopia Oromia urban land cadastral map Ziway official
queries.result: Found the first-party Oromia Land Bureau, Oromia urban-planning bureau, and Ethiopian Ministry of Justice urban-cadastral directive. The only clearly public e-Land map/viewer found is Addis Ababa-specific; no Ziway parcel viewer or downloadable city parcel API was found.

queries.query: ዝዋይ ኢትዮጵያ ካዳስተር የመሬት ምዝገባ ካርታ ኦፊሴላዊ; Ziway Oromiyaa kaadaastarii kaartaa galmee lafaa mootummaa
queries.result: The Amharic/Afaan Oromo first-party discovery surfaced the same Oromia Land Bureau and general cadastral-policy sources, but no Ziway-specific public parcel service or safe anonymous parcel response.

freshResearch.sourceAssessment: First-party regional/national sources were found, but local Ziway registry custody and a public parcel-data route were not evidenced. Anonymous probing was limited to public HTML/JavaScript and safe route existence checks.

parcelEvidence.note: No official public Ziway parcel endpoint or bounded ID-plus-geometry response was identified. This is a discovery/service-coverage limitation, not evidence of citywide parcel absence; the WUP point was not shifted.
